result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues: category chips and restaurant cards overflow the screen, names are truncated, a loading spinner sits on a restaurant image, and the last card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is clipped at the right edge and a partial next chip is visible, with no clear indication that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with fade/peek affordance or wrap chips so all labels are fully visible.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is cut off on the right and the restaurant name is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol').
issues.suggestion: Ensure cards fit the viewport or show a clear horizontal-scroll peek, and prevent name truncation (wrap or ellipsis with full name on tap).

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20%) is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/safe-area inset so content can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: A loading spinner is overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, making the listing look incomplete or broken.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image is loaded, or use a dedicated skeleton/placeholder instead of covering the photo.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) icons sit on the restaurant images without a strong contrast background, so they can be hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Add a semi-opaque circular backdrop or increase icon contrast so the control is always visible.
